svg.title: Token-only mNAV of five crypto treasury companies at the October 9, 2026 close
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart of five crypto treasury companies, which hold one crypto token as their main treasury asset. Token-only mNAV, the share price divided by the value of the reported tokens per common share, at the October 9, 2026 close. Hyperion DeFi (HYPD), which holds HYPE, 0.34. StablecoinX (USDE), which holds ENA, 0.46. Forward Industries (FWDI), which holds SOL, 0.61. Strategy (MSTR), which holds BTC, 0.93. Strive (ASST), which holds BTC, 1.16. A dashed line marks 1, where the share price equals token NAV per share.
svg.text: StablecoinX was second lowest of five crypto treasury companies on token-only mNAV
Share price divided by token NAV per share at 4 pm New York time on October 9, 2026
Share price equals token NAV per share

g.title: Hyperion DeFi (HYPD). 1,850,000 HYPE reported as of September 30, 2026, 15,442,482 common shares as of September 30, 2026. Close $3.40. HYPE $83.38, the last Kraken trade before 20:00 UTC. Token NAV per share $9.99, mNAV 0.340

Forward Industries (FWDI). 8,501,298 SOL reported as of September 30, 2026, 76,288,215 common shares as of September 30, 2026. Close $7.34. SOL $108.38, the last Kraken trade before 20:00 UTC. Token NAV per share $12.08, mNAV 0.608

Strategy (MSTR). 848,000 BTC reported as of October 4, 2026, 422,070,802 common shares as of October 4, 2026. Close $154.34. BTC $82,252.40, the last Kraken trade before 20:00 UTC. Token NAV per share $165.26, mNAV 0.934

Strive (ASST). 29,462 BTC reported as of October 2, 2026, 100,938,986 common shares as of October 2, 2026. Close $27.80. BTC $82,252.40, the last Kraken trade before 20:00 UTC. Token NAV per share $24.01, mNAV 1.158

svg.text: Token NAV per share is each company's token count from its SEC filings to October 9 times the token's last Kraken trade
before 20:00 UTC, divided by common shares from its filings. Cash, other assets, debt and preferred stock are left out.
Closes from S&P Global Market Intelligence through StockAnalysis, matched with Yahoo Finance. Sources read October 12, 2026 UTC.
